name: Example: hourly splunkd errors
description: Every hour: counts the errors splunkd logged in the hour before, by component, and keeps them in a lookup; emails when there were more than 5 kinds; then counts the warnings of the same hour. An email goes out if a search fails. Searches top to bottom, so it fits the Simple view.

steps.name: Count splunkd errors
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR
| stats count AS errors BY component
| sort - errors
| eval hour=strftime($run.scheduled_time$, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00")

actions.subject: {{job}}: splunkd errors in $count_errors.resultCount$ components
actions.message:
The top one was $count_errors.first.component$ with $count_errors.first.errors$ errors.

{{run_url}}

steps.name: Count splunkd warnings
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=WARN
| stats count AS warnings BY component
| sort - warnings
